Q1_METRICS_SEMANTICALLY_CLEAN.basis: V1 fingerprint matched; adverse/supportive overlap is zero; progress rulers have explicit meanings

Q2_WAIT_BEHAVIOUR_ACCEPTABLE.basis: compares avoided failures, missed supportive movement, already-consumed movement, and unresolved ACTIVE no-entry lifecycles

Q3_STRUCTURAL_LOSS_BEHAVIOUR_ACCEPTABLE.basis: uses first-causal exit integrity and accepted-falsification overshoot relative to frozen entry invalidation geometry

Q4_SIDE_SWITCHING_IS_STRUCTURALLY_EXPLAI.basis: compares factual structural reassessment categories with possible same-structure churn

Q5_MOVEMENT_PARTICIPATION_QUALITY.basis: requires supportive-landmark and positive retained-progress majorities in both buckets

Q6_TEACH_VALIDATE_BEHAVIOUR_REPEATABLE.basis: compares qualitative majority, retained-sign, WAIT, switch, and falsification facts without a fitted tolerance

Q7_READY_FOR_PRODUCTION_INTEGRATION.basis: requires causal V1 integrity, clean metrics, no negative WAIT/loss/switch gate, positive movement quality, and repeatable qualitative behaviour

gate_policy.loss: first-causal exits plus overshoot relative to original invalidation distance
gate_policy.switch: structurally classified transitions vs possible same-structure churn
gate_policy.wait: categorical majority among avoided-failure vs missed-supportive outcomes

D1_MOVEMENT_STATE_CAUSAL.basis: immutable closed-candle movement states were emitted inside every source barrier

D2_HYPOTHESIS_LIFECYCLE_CAUSAL.basis: hypotheses were born, updated, and terminally classified from current-or-prior facts

D3_PARTICIPATION_SEPARATE_FROM_HYPOTHESI.basis: both buckets contain active hypotheses that remained flat for structural reasons

D4_STRUCTURAL_INVALIDATION_WORKS.basis: every entry carried factual invalidation and no exit lagged a first falsification

D5_NO_AUTOMATIC_REVERSAL.basis: same-candle opposite shadow entry after exit is absent

D6_SHADOW_TRADER_CAN_FOLLOW_MOVEMENT.basis: entries followed causal hypothesis formation, structural landmarks were reached, exits were causal, and behaviour appeared in multiple source episodes in both buckets

D7_READY_FOR_EXECUTION_RESEARCH.basis: this remains a research-only shadow machine without execution, costs, or unseen-forward study
